title: Sellable Status
description: Sellable Status v1 contract. Sellable requires released batch, warehouse receipt confirmed, inventory ledger pass, stock available, HSD valid, QC clear, trace ready, no recall, and no sale lock.
$comment: Sources: PACK-01 Sellable Gate and PACK-02 Product Activation dependency. TODO: exact sellable decision status taxonomy is not fully specified.

sellable_status_id.description: Sellable status identifier. Resolvable through GET /v1/sellable-statuses/{id} ONLY when it came from an ops-core.sellable.* event. The value returned by POST /v1/availability/check is ephemeral - that path does not persist, so treat it as a correlation token; looking it up returns 404.

batch_released.description: True when batch release is complete.

warehouse_receipt_confirmed.description: True when warehouse receipt is confirmed.

inventory_ledger_pass.description: True when ledger supports the stock state.

stock_available.description: True when available stock is greater than zero and not held.

hsd_valid.description: True when shelf life/HSD is valid.

quality_hold.description: True when quality hold blocks sellable.

recall_hold.description: True when recall hold blocks sellable.

sale_lock.description: True when sale lock blocks sellable.

trace_ready.description: True when trace chain is ready.

block_reasons.description: Reasons blocking sellable status. Exactly the 11 tokens OpSellableStatus.GetBlockReasons emits; see enums/ops/sellable-block-reason.v1.yaml.

uom_code.description: Quantity block. Echoes the request uom_code. Present only when the request supplied uom_code; absent otherwise, together with the seven properties below. Ordinal match - no case folding, no conversion, no mixed-UOM aggregation.

warehouse_scope.description: Quantity block. ALL when the request omitted warehouse_id, WAREHOUSE when it supplied one. A warehouse_id that does not resolve to an ACTIVE warehouse returns 404 - it never silently falls back to ALL.

check_mode.description: Quantity block. EXISTENCE when the request omitted requested_quantity, FULL_FILL when it supplied one. FULL_FILL passes only when the whole requested amount is coverable; there is no partial fulfilment.

available_quantity.description: Quantity block. Total physically on hand in uom_code. Invariant: available_quantity >= sellable_quantity >= 0.

sellable_quantity.description: Quantity block. The part actually sellable in uom_code - reservations and the three hold buckets already deducted.

fulfillable.description: Quantity block. True only when decision is SELLABLE AND the requested amount is fully coverable. A lot holding 1000 boxes under an active sale lock is false.

resolved_at.description: Quantity block. UTC instant the quantities were resolved, truncated to the second. Must end with Z.

valid_until.description: Quantity block. resolved_at + 5 seconds. A consumer must not reuse the quantities past this instant.

$comment_quantity_block: The eight quantity properties were merged in from the retired POST /v2/availability/check under OWNER-DIRECTIVE-2026-09-09-AVAILABILITY-V1-ONLY. They are purely additive: a request that omits uom_code gets a response byte-for-byte identical to the pre-merge shape. v2 declared a closed 15-token block_reasons enum that forced a projection layer over the 11 tokens the domain actually emits - renaming HSD_NOT_VALID to HSD_EXPIRED, splitting STOCK_NOT_AVAILABLE in two, folding SKU_ACTIVATION_NOT_ACTIVE away, and demoting INVENTORY_LEDGER_NOT_PASSED (a data inconsistency) to PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE (a transport word). Merging into v1 deleted that layer; block_reasons now carries the producer vocabulary unchanged.
